purpose: Codex follow-up review 29.09 (7.6): the fact lifecycle of the dialogue state, read from the saved facts and not from model.accepted. A new fact is added, a correction replaces the right person's fact and keeps another person's fact of the same topic, a retraction ends a fact and the next turn does not bring it back; a fact or change left out without an allowance fails. Written before any run.

expectation_help.facts_present / facts_absent: a current fact of the person whose quote matches the pattern is / is not in the saved state
expectation_help.fact_changes: a fact of the person whose quote matches has become superseded or retracted
expectation_help.allowed_dropped: a new fact, change, period or state the server left out passes only with its own allowance; absent here, so every such drop fails

turns.text: Mul on võlgu 2000 eurot ja minu emal on võlgu 5000 eurot. Elame mõlemad Harku vallas.
Vabandust, minu enda võlg on hoopis 3000 eurot.
Olen töötu ja elan Kose vallas. Mul on kaks last.
Tegelikult ma ei ole töötu, töötan osalise ajaga.
